praxis.label: Praxis AI Proxy — one HTTP listener

ingress.title: HTTP Listener
ingress.description: Single Praxis HTTP listener. Named filter_chains are concatenated at startup. Path does not select a chain — path_classify + branch_chains dispatch specialist stacks.

f_auth.title: auth (planned)
f_auth.description: Validates API key via MaaS. Shared security trunk before the branch point.

f_rlimit.title: rate_limit
f_rlimit.description: Built-in Praxis rate limit on the shared security trunk.

f_rguard.title: ai_guardrails
f_rguard.description: External NeMo content safety on the shared trunk (request) and after upstream (response).

f_classify.title: path_classify (planned)
f_classify.description: Maps request path to filter_results.api so branch_chains can select a specialist arm. Branches cannot match URI natively — they match on_result.

branch_responses.title: branch: responses
branch_responses.description: on_result api=responses. Specialist stack aligned with examples/configs/openai/responses/full-flow.yaml. Rejoins parent with rejoin: next.

branch_chat.title: branch: chat
branch_chat.description: on_result api=chat. Chat Completions path: promote model, optional API translation.

branch_inference.title: branch: inference
branch_inference.description: on_result api=inference. Pool-oriented prep before shared egress endpoint_picker.

r_format.title: openai_responses_format
r_format.description: Classifies Responses requests; promotes x-praxis-ai-* headers and mode for downstream filters.

r_tool.title: openai_tool_parse
r_tool.description: Promotes tool composition facts for nested branches.

r_store.title: openai_response_store
r_store.description: Persists responses; registers store for rehydrate.

r_file.title: openai_file_resolve
r_file.description: Resolves file_id references via Files API.

c_m2h.title: model_to_header
c_m2h.description: Extracts model to X-Model for routing.

i_bmth.title: base_model_to_header (planned)
i_bmth.description: Resolves LoRA adapter to base model for pod affinity.

f_cred.title: credential_injection
f_cred.description: Shared egress: inject per-cluster provider credentials after branch rejoin.

f_epp.title: endpoint_picker (planned)
f_epp.description: GIE selection semantics in-process after rejoin. Emphasized for inference arm / InferencePool.

f_router.title: router + load_balancer
f_router.description: Path/header match selects cluster only — not which filter stack ran (that was the branch).

maas.title: MaaS API
maas.description: External key validation callback from auth.

nixl.title: NIXL
nixl.description: KV transfer between prefill and decode.
